tools.name: get-actor-run
tools.description: Returns status, storages, stats, and a short summary for one Actor run. Use after starting a run, or with waitSecs to wait for a terminal status.

tools.name: get-dataset-items
tools.description: Returns rows from a dataset produced by an Actor run. Use when you have a datasetId and need the result items.

tools.name: get-key-value-store-record
tools.description: Returns one record from a key-value store by store id and record key. Use for INPUT, OUTPUT, or other named records.

tools.name: abort-actor-run
tools.description: Requests abort of an Actor run that is starting or running. No effect if the run already finished.

tools.name: gouda_studios--sam-gov-opportunities-feed
tools.description: Returns SAM.gov federal contract opportunities as JSON, filterable by keyword, NAICS, set-aside, notice type, agency, and state. Use for new or matching notices.

tools.name: gouda_studios--sec-edgar-filings-feed
tools.description: Returns SEC EDGAR filings for tickers or CIKs (8-K, 10-Q, 10-K, Form 4, Form D, S-1) with filing dates and document links. Use for company filing monitoring.

tools.name: gouda_studios--usaspending-awards-search
tools.description: Searches USAspending.gov federal awards by keyword, recipient, agency, NAICS, state, date, and amount. Use to find contracts and grants.

tools.name: gouda_studios--gleif-company-lei-lookup
tools.description: Looks up a company LEI by name, or returns LEI details by identifier, from the GLEIF registry (legal name, status, jurisdiction, addresses, parents). Use for company identity checks.

tools.name: gouda_studios--website-contact-extractor
tools.description: Extracts public emails, phones, social links, and addresses from a list of websites, one deduplicated row per site. Use for contact discovery on public pages.

tools.name: gouda_studios--youtube-transcript-extractor
tools.description: Returns YouTube video or Short transcripts as plain text, timestamped text, segments, or SRT. Use when you need captions or spoken content from a video URL.

tools.name: gouda_studios--google-trends-explorer
tools.description: Returns Google Trends interest-over-time, region interest, related queries/topics, and daily trends for keywords. Use for search-interest research.
